Messages.Body:
In article <5g4qdm$c...@camel2.mindspring.com>,
guenh...@mindspring.com wrote:
> >>The DCI vote rules: These are the Official tournament rules for voting.
> >>These rules say that any vote cards used during a turn may not be replaced
> >>until the current turn is over (I could be off a little bit, as our group
> >>does not use these rules, we use the above rules).
>
> I would specify that they are not replaced until the current minion
> phase is over. This helps avoid ambiguity as to when the replacement
> occurs with respect to discarding.
>

The DCI rules state that PAs burned for votes are not replaced until
the end of the turn. This is after the discard phase.

The Sabbat rules state that PAs burned for votes are not replaced
until the end of the current minion phase.

When playing in a sanctioned DCI tournament, the DCI rules override
any stock rules that they conflict with. This is the explicit
function of the DCI rules.

So, if you choose to play with DCI rules, then PAs burned for votes
are not replaced until the end of the turn.
